posts.title: dotFly - a fruit fly’s brain, simulated in C#
posts.description: Running the complete fruit fly connectome (166,700 neurons, 25 M synapses) as a spiking network in pure .NET, inside a game loop - and being honest about what that is and what it is not.

posts.title: ZeroGC: an allocate-only garbage collector for .NET
posts.description: A custom CoreCLR GC that only ever allocates and never reclaims memory - the simplest possible baseline for writing a real one, and a fun toy for measuring how GC-bound your app really is.

posts.title: Introducing dotLLM - Building an LLM Inference Engine in C#
posts.description: How I built a ground-up LLM inference engine in .NET 10, and what I learned about AI-assisted (not vibe-coded) development along the way.
